page0.text:
For the final time...
I see that red hill once again.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page0:1

page1.text:
The red memory.
I dive deeper into her memory, and I realize I'm seeing it for the last time.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page1:1

page2.text:
It's a memory of a certain knight that I have seen many times already.
After becoming king and killing her will so that she could devote herself to the will of her nation, her days were now marked by the resentment of her trusted knights.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page2:1

page3.text:
Every time she won a battle, Altria was made to fight more battles she didn't want.
She continued to hide her sex, which heaped more suspicion onto her. All that awaited the isolated girl was rebellion at the hands of her own family.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page3:1

page4.text:
A young knight took over the nation while the king was away on an expedition.
The knight's name was Mordred.
The knight, son of Altria's older sister, Morgan, was in fact the King of Knights' own son.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page4:1

page5.text:
Altria was never able to have a child as a woman.
But Mordred had her blood coursing through his veins.
I'm not clear what happened to make this possible...but Altria's older sister, Morgan, loathed her for becoming king.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page5:1

page6.text: Mordred was created as a clone, and served the king without knowing who his father was. Mordred sought an opportunity to take the throne for himself, ultimately going so far as to organize a revolt.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page6:1

page7.text:
That revolt would end in what later became known as the Battle of Camlann.
The final battle, and the end of King Arthur.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page7:1

page8.text:
King Arthur learned of Mordred's betrayal during her expedition and returned with her weary army to invade her own lands.
She defeated many of the knights who used to serve her.
She attacked the lands she once defended.
Those few knights who remained loyal to her, died. The only two left standing in the end were the king and her son, Mordred.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page8:1

page9.text:
The combat between the two of them ended in the king's victory.
But the king was not unharmed.
Mordred was bound by a powerful curse, and swung his sword even after dying, inflicting a fatal wound on the king.
And so that battle ended.
It was the end of her, the king once known as the King of Knights.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page9:1

page10.text:
It must have been heart-wrenching.
None of the battles she fought were painless.
Every one of the twelve battles she fought was intense, but this final one was her greatest loss.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page10:1

page11.text:
She returned to her homeland, only to have to destroy her own army...
She was forced to punish the knights who once served her, and had to watch those knights who remained loyal to her die.
And in the end, she had to kill her own son.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page11:1

page12.text:
I have no idea what was going through her head in that moment.
But I had to pray.
I had to pray for the lone knight who tried to remain king until the very end.
I pray that this dream of her just before her death is the kind of dream a girl named Altria would want to see.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page12:1

page13.text:
"Hnnngh."
I open my eyes.
I don't know when I got back, but I'm in my room, lying on my futon.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page13:1

page14.text:
"Ah, Shirou. You are awake."
"Saber. How did I...?"
"You have been sleeping for some time. You are mostly healed now, so there is no cause for concern."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page14:1

page15.text:
"I see. I guess that's good."
But what about Saber?
She used Excalibur. She must be running low on magical energy, since she probably healed herself too.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page15:1

page16.text:
"Saber, were you taking care of me the whole time?"
"All I did was to wipe the sweat from your brow. I cannot treat wounds like Rin."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page16:1

page17.text:
"You dummy. You didn't have to do that.
You're probably suffering too."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page17:1

page18.text:
"That is not true. My wounds were insignificant compared to yours.
However, on that subject... Though your wounds have healed, they were severe enough that you might have died. You must be mindful of your body and its limits right now."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page18:1

page19.text:
Saber reaches for a basin of water that sits beside her.
She draws a towel out of it and wrings it before wiping me off with the cool water.
"...Ah..."
Honestly, what she does mostly just embarrasses me.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page19:1

page20.text: "Hm? Does your wound still hurt? You fever does not seem to have gone down..."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page20:1

page21.text:
"I-I...I don't have a fever! Um...that's not what I mean. I want you to rest too.
You might be fine right now, but you still used Excalibur. You should be resting, or you might collapse again like last time."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page21:1

page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page22:1

page23.text:
"But I am better off than you are right now. It is only proper that I should protect my Master until his wounds are healed."
"Uh...well, I guess that makes sense..."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page23:1

page24.text:
She's got me there.
When she says it like that, I can't really do anything but agree.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page24:1

page25.text:
"Fine. I'm going to rest, so I want you to rest too, Saber. I won't be able to sleep, knowing you aren't resting.
"That...is true. And I do require sleep."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page25:1

page26.text:
Saber nods in agreement, then wrings the towel and hangs it over the edge of the basin.
I do my best to swallow my embarrassment as I watch Saber tend to me.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page26:1

page27.text:
"I will go rest.
Please take care, Shirou."
"Uh...okay."
"Good night.
I forgot to say so earlier, but thank you, Shirou."
I am very glad you are okay."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page27:1

page28.text:
There, under the moonlight, I see Saber smile.
Her smile seems...fragile. Maybe because of the pale moonlight.
Before I get a good look, the door closes.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page28:1

page29.text:
"...Hah."
When Saber disappears into her room, I'm stricken by a sudden sense of relief...or maybe loneliness.
I regret not telling her to stay here and just take my futon while I use my arm as a pillow, but that would be too much for her.
Besides, if we did that, it'd remind me of that night.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page29:1

page30.text:
I shake off the image that works its way into my mind.
Too many things have happened today. It feels like an entire week has gone by just today.
My date with Saber was more challenging than fun, then we got in an argument and I left, abandoning Saber.
And then...
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page30:1

page31.text:
...
...No. I shouldn't think of that until I've completely recovered.
Not only do we have to deal with Gilgamesh, but we also need to defeat Lancer and whoever his Master is.
We need to rest, recover, and regroup so we can be at our best, or else we don't have a chance at winning.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page31:1

page32.text:
"..."
This only happened a few hours ago.
I think Saber said something about me being her sheath.
At the time, I couldn't ask what she meant. I was a wreck and near to passing out.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page32:1

page33.text:
"Argh...oh come on!"
I can't fall asleep.
And Saber's dream... Her face, resolute even on the brink of death, overlaps with the sight of Saber tending to me.
Then I hear her voice saying, "Good night."
The image of her frail profile, of her smile is burned into my mind.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page33:1

page34.text:
"..."
It's not a smile I saw in any of my dreams of her life.
She says it makes her happier when she sees me smile.
That just drives me nuts.
I'm not sad. Just...exasperated.
I don't know why it annoys me so much I actually find myself getting angry.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page34:1

page35.text:
I punch my futon.
The desire to lash out in the face of this frustration just completely overwhelms me.
"Shirou? Is something the matter?"
A concerned voice drifts in from the other side of the closed door.
My breathing is heavy, so she must think I'm having trouble sleeping.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page35:1

page36.text:
"No, it's okay. But why are you still awake?"
"Are...you truly all right? If you are still in pain, I can remain by your side."
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page36:1

page37.text:
Maybe I should go over—no, that's even worse.
All the pent-up feelings I've been barely holding back will come rushing to the forefront if I see Saber now.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page37:1

page38.text:
"Saber...can I talk to you for a bit?"
"Hm? Yes, if you do not mind talking like this..."
We start talking through the sliding door.
Since I can't actually see her, I think back on that smile, the last expression I saw on her face.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page38:1

page39.text:
She looked so happy.
And when I think of it, I find myself getting more frustrated, rather than less.
I don't know why I'm getting so...warm.
But I still need to talk to Saber.
I have to tell her that even if I don't have the right answer, she's still wrong.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page39:1

page40.text:
My voice trembles. My tongue feels heavy in my mouth.
Once I say it, I won't be able to take it back.
I'm fully aware of that.
"It's okay. Just...things are fine, so you need to smile for yourself."
Some unknown force forces the words from me.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page40:1

page41.text:
"Shi...rou? What do you... Why?"
There shouldn't even be a question.
I'll just keep repeating myself until you realize it.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page41:1

page42.text:
"Saber. You've done enough. You worked hard enough. You fought so hard, all on your own.
That's why...it wouldn't be right unless you found happiness.
You fulfilled your vow. That gives you the right to go back to being Altria."
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page42:1

page43.text:
"What? You still want to talk about this?"
"Yeah. I'm going to keep saying it! I can't help it! I fell for you! So, you should go back to being you...no, Altria...!"
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page43:1

page44.text:
I suppress the sudden surge of emotion.
I'm on the verge of breaking down.
If only Saber would just say something, even a single word...
"...Shirou. Please, do not...
If you say that, I..."
Her answer is unchanged.
My heart aches from her determination.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page44:1

page45.text:
"You have come into me both physically and spiritually, despite knowing my past. You should know very well what answer I would have to give...
So why do you still concern yourself with me?
You must have seen all the sins I have committed."
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page45:1

page46.text:
Yeah, I have.
Many people were sacrificed in the name of the king. Many enemies killed.
I have no intention of pretending that didn't happen.
Still, knowing this, I want Altria to be happy.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page46:1

page47.text:
"Yeah. So? I don't understand this feeling, but I can't just let you stay like this.
I want you to smile, Saber. I want to be with you forever."
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page47:1

page48.text:
It's such a childish confession of love.
I wait for her answer as the silence stretches out between us.
What Saber might be doing, or how she might be reacting behind that closed door, I have no idea.
Are my words even getting through to her?
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page48:1

page49.text:
"...My answer will never change.
I cannot break the vow I made as king. I may not have been fit to rule, but my nation was still entrusted to me.
And since I failed in my duties...I cannot...I cannot accept this freedom."
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page49:1

page50.text:
Her voice is so sad, I can't stand it any longer.
I don't want to hear the solitary oath Altria took when she became king.
I already know it.
All this frustration wasn't just so I could hear her lamentations.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page50:1

page51.text:
I kick at the futon covers.
The only thing between me and Saber is the sliding door leading to her room.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page51:1

page52.text:
"Shirou..."
The door slides softly as I open it.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page52:1

page53.text:
"..."
My mind goes blank.
What was I so angry about? Why was I so sad?
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page53:1

page54.text:
Before me, I see trembling eyes, on the verge of tears.
I see a slender neck, and shoulders so thin, they seem in danger of snapping in a breeze.
And I see her golden hair, splashed with moonlight, just like when we first met.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page54:1

page55.text:
...
Without even thinking, I'm embracing her.
I hold her so tight I might break her.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page55:1

page56.text:
It's different from that night.
I didn't feel like this back then.
This may sound ridiculous.
Even though I was aspiring to be a champion of justice...
I never fell in love. There was never someone I couldn't let go of.
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page56:1

page57.text:
"Saber..."
It's...like she might disappear if I don't hold her tightly enough.
I'm not sure how long I hold her, but I relax my embrace after reminding myself that no, she won't disappear.
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page57:1

page58.text: "Shirou...what is this, all of sudden? What is the meaning of this? Even if you do that, I will not..."
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page58:1

page59.text:
She moves slightly in my arms.
Her lips tremble. She's about to say something I don't want to hear...
"...Ah..."
So I place my lips over hers to silence her.
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page59:1

page60.text:
She trembles in my arms.
I'm looking at Saber, but I'm not seeing anything.
But my sense of touch has grown so much more sensitive now. I can feel the softness of Saber's lips.
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page60:1

page61.text:
Our lips part.
Saber places a hand on my chest and pushes me away gently.
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page61:1

page62.text:
"...Shirou. That kiss..."
She wants to say it was a mistake.
Saber looks at me, on the verge of tears.
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page62:1

page63.text:
"It wasn't a mistake. I'll say it as many times as I can. I love you, and I can't let you go.
If you don't want that, tell me.
Tell me that our relationship is just Master and Servant. If that's what you really want, then say so directly. Reject me."
"That is unfair. How can you ask me to do that?"
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page63:1

page64.text:
"Yeah. If you don't tell me directly, I'm not going to hold back.
If you don't reject me, I'll just do what I want."
Even if it could only make her forget her vow to be king for a moment.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page64:1

page65.text:
...
Neither of us says anything for what feels like a long time.
I keep holding Saber, feeling her soft, slender body...
She's still tense, unsure of herself.
All I can hear is our breathing and our hearts beating.
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page65:1

page66.text:
How many times did our hearts beat against each other?
She pushes a little harder on my chest.
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page66:1

page67.text:
"I cannot reciprocate your feelings. As you cannot change, so there are things I cannot change about myself.
If anything... If it is allowed...it would be..."
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page67:1

page68.text:
The pause makes my heart ache.
She bites her lip, trembling, as if confessing that what we did that night was not permitted.
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page68:1

page69.text:
And yet...
...her body offers no resistance, and the hesitation in her eyes tells me something.
Just one night...
She's telling me of a hope she feels cannot be fulfilled... She wants to stay like this until the night ends.
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page69:1

page70.text:
"Saber, I..."
I lift my hand, trying to embrace her.
Saber takes hold of it.
"I...since I used my Noble Phantasm...if I do not receive energy from you...I cannot continue fighting."
Her hushed voice, asking for permission, falls silent.
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page70:1

page71.text:
...
I have no words.
That line of reasoning is so, so transparent, but it's the best she could do to ask for her wish to come true.
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page71:1

page72.text:
"Oh...right. But do you know if the connection's still working properly?"
"Yes. You are supplying me with energy as we speak.
Which is why, to more fully recover, we should..."
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page72:1

page73.text:
Our bodies have to be close.
It's all we can do.
This is as close as we can be...because she is still bound by her oath. I can't break that oath.
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page73:1

page74.text:
Saber moves in my arms.
I don't know what to do with the heat of her pressed against me.
Holding Saber's slender body in my arms makes my heart beat faster.
And I'm ashamed of myself for getting...agitated.
Saber's cheeks practically glow red. She looks so embarrassed.
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page74:1

page75.text:
"And so Shirou...if I may ask...
Please allow me to sleep with you tonight. When the sword and sheath are together, it is easier for them to restore their strength. And if we bring our bodies and souls close together like we did during that ritual..."
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page75:1

page76.text:
...
I nod silently.
I'm much happier than I am embarrassed.
I get to spend the night with Saber in my arms. Our bodies may not touch more than they are now, but we can be more intimate in our hearts.
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page76:1

page77.text:
"I am glad. Then, Shirou...
I will prepare myself for tonight, so please return to your room."
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page77:1

page78.text:
Saber stands up.
I can't bear to let her go, but we can't stay like this forever, so I head back through the sliding door to my room.
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page78:1

page79.text:
I turn back to look at Saber before I slide the door shut.
It feels like I'm doing something wrong though, so I close the door quickly.
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page79:1

page80.text:
...
I don't know why but I find myself sitting on top of my futon.
My mind won't slow down. It's practically doing somersaults just at the thought of sleeping with Saber. This is for her. To help her. To grant one small wish of hers.
If I keep on granting these small wishes for her, it'll add up, and maybe Saber will learn to smile.
But the war is nearing its end. I don't know how much time we have left to keep doing this.
page80.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page80:1

page81.text:
"Excuse me, Shirou."
The sliding door opens.
I shake away the depressing thoughts circling my head and look to Saber.
I turn and look up at her. She's...
page81.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page81:1

page82.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page82:1

page83.text:
She is a figure of pure white in the darkness.
Seeing her, all that restless worry I felt melts away.
She's just too beautiful.
My heart is unclouded now.
page83.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page83:1

page84.text:
"Do you think it is strange for me to be in this?"
"Uh...n-no, absolutely not. It's just that you're so beautiful, I don't know what to do...
page84.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page84:1

page85.text:
I mutter something unintelligible...about how difficult it makes things when a girl's too pretty.
Even if I explain it to Saber, she wouldn't understand, but my mind's practically shorted out.
page85.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page85:1

page86.text:
"May I go over there, Shirou?"
"Oh...uh...sure."
For the first time, I realize she has beautiful, perfect toes.
While Saber walks across the tatami mat floor to get close, I get off the futon and pull the blanket back for her.
page86.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page86:1

page87.text:
I realize I'm one pillow short for the two of us to sleep together, but it's too late.
Saber and I sit side by side next to the futon.
page87.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page87:1

page88.text:
One room, one futon, but Saber's with me.
I shouldn't be having any impure thoughts, but my face feels like it's on fire; I can't even look at Saber.
page88.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page88:1

page89.text:
"Please go ahead, Shirou."
"No, you go ahead, Saber."
page89.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page89:1

page90.text:
Well...we're not going to get anywhere like this.
So, I hurry into the futon and make room for Saber.
I thought I would give her the pillow, but she gently pushes is back to me.
page90.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page90:1

page91.text:
"You should take this, Shirou.
I would like to, um...use your arm as my pillow."
Her words, barely a whisper, make my heart skip a beat.
Saber is surprisingly calm as she nestles into my arms.
It's like she's settled in herself more than I am holding her.
page91.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page91:1

page92.text:
A blade and its sheath.
I remember Saber's words.
Saber is about to drift off, pillowed on my arm, like a sword in its sheath.
Her warm, soft scent so close in calms rather than excites me.
page92.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page92:1

page93.text:
"..."
Saber's hand reaches for my hand.
I take it inside the blanket, and I entwine my fingers with hers.
And we drift off to sleep in silence.
But before that...
page93.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page93:1

page94.text:
"Saber."
I call out to her as she lays beside me.
I want to ask her at the end.
I want to hear again why I desire her so much.
page94.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page94:1

page95.text:
"Do you feel it, Shirou? My magical energy should be fully replenished by tomorrow morning if we continue as we are. By tomorrow, I will be able to fight as your Servant."
"Saber."
page95.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page95:1

page96.text:
"This is all I need, Shirou.
My role is to protect you and to obtain the Holy Grail. Until the war is over, I cannot think of anything else."
"That..."
"Do you not agree, Shirou?"
page96.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page96:1

page98.text:
...
...
While the two of us lie quiet, we look out into the tranquil darkness.
I don't know how much time passes.
My eyelids grow heavy. My body cries out for rest.
But our entwined fingers stay warm.
page98.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page99:1

page99.text:
"Saber...?"
"Yes. Let us do the thinking tomorrow, Shirou.
We may come up with a good idea tomorrow. And..."
She just wants to sleep together like this.
She holds my hand gently as she says so.
page99.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page100:1

page100.text:
"Yeah. I was thinking the same thing."
"Yes. Good night, Shirou. When we wake, matters will return to normal."
I lean my face close to hers and close my eyes.
page100.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page101:1

page101.text:
The last thing I see is Saber smiling warmly.
I don't care if that moment of vulnerability was only for tonight.
The hand holding mine right now is so, so warm.
It's more than enough for me, and I fall into a satisfied sleep.
page101.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page102:1

page102.text:
...The end of battle.
Once everything is over, I'm not sure I can keep holding this hand. And then silence settles in.
page102.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-11:page103:1
